name: Muhammad Syakirurohman
headline: Hi There 👋, Syakir Here!
bio:
I am a Front-end Engineer from Indonesia. I love sharing what i know on [devaradise.com](https://devaradise.com), and sometime i also share freebies like this. I'm also active on [dev.to](https://dev.to/syakirurahman) and [twitter](https://x.com/syakirurahman).

I made Devolio to help you easily set up your own blog and portfolio website. It's a static site built with Astro and Tailwind CSS, and you can deploy it on platforms like [Netlify](https://app.netlify.com/start/deploy?repository=https://github.com/devaradise/devolio), [Vercel](https://vercel.com/new/clone?repository-url=https%3A%2F%2Fgithub.com%2Fdevaradise%2Fdevolio), or [Cloudflare Pages](https://pages.cloudflare.com/).
